data.long_meaning: Aret is a Greek name derived from the word 'arete', meaning virtue or excellence. In ancient Greek culture, arete was considered the highest moral virtue, representing a person's character and worth. In Christian tradition, Aret is associated with spiritual growth and moral development. The name Aret carries the meaning “Virtue, Excellence” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Aret usually hope their child will grow to embody virtue, excellence and live with faith, good character and purpose.
